selection: Acquired objective among candidates passing the projected-gradient check; otherwise provisional lowest objective.
rationale: Disable objective-change stopping; retain a tiny step safeguard. Audit all eight saved candidates without changing priors, noise, bounds or component count.
limitations: Projected-gradient norm depends on the frozen parameter units; it is a stationarity diagnostic, not a global-optimality certificate.
A step-tolerance exit is not accepted unless the projected-gradient check passes.
Additional 600 evaluations per candidate; no automatic budget extension or withheld tuning.
